_doc: Registers per thread of each potrf kernel instantiation, per arch: capacity facts that feed the plan's occupancy estimate (fit.py passes them to potrf_plan_dump --regs). Keys: t8/t16/t32 = Tiny buckets N, cta_sg = CTA at L == 32 (Scope::SubGroup), cta_wg = CTA at L > 32 (Scope::WorkGroup; also the Blocked leaf), lp = LPanel at NB 8, lp16 = LPanel float NB 16. A key absent means unknown (the cap is not applied).

sm_120._source: PROBED 2026-10-01: ptxas -v on an sm_120 device link of build/src/.../potrf_{tiny,cta,lpanel}.cc.o (dpcpp-cuda clang++ 24.0.0, CUDA 13.2, Release); 0 B stack, 0 spill for every entry

sm_89._source: Tiny: docs/perf/potrf.md register-probe table; CTA: the sm_89 probe (SG / non-SG); LPanel: NOT probed on sm_89 -- the sm_120 probe is reused (flagged)
